item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.10

  • Text formatting in notes: select text for a floating Bold / Italic / Underline bar, or press ⌘B, ⌘I and ⌘U. Formatting is kept as plain markdown in the note, so export and sync stay plain text
  • Lists: type "- " for a bullet list or "1. " for a numbered one. Return carries the list on, numbers stay in step, and Return on an empty item ends it
  • Flip through your notes in place: the ← → arrows in a note's header, or ⌘[ and ⌘], step the open window through the deck without moving it
  • ⌥⌘O reopens the note you were most recently in, from any app. Like every shortcut, it can be changed in Settings › Keyboard
  • Settings › General › Dock style: keep the dots, or rest the deck as a small stack of notes at the edge of the screen
  • All Notes: opening a note closes the window, the previewed note is highlighted clearly, and ⌘A in the search selects the search text
  • Notes open on the display you clicked them from
  • Notes and the deck follow the full-screen setting on every display
